result.finding: Two volumes configured for the Oracle Database service in docker-compose.yml: one named volume for database data persistence and one bind mount for initialization scripts. The Java application container has no volumes — photos are stored as BLOBs in Oracle DB, not on the filesystem.
evidence: No VOLUME instruction in Dockerfile (application container is stateless regarding filesystem)
docker-compose.yml oracle-db service: named volume 'oracle_data' mounted at /opt/oracle/oradata for database persistence
docker-compose.yml oracle-db service: bind mount './oracle-init' -> '/container-entrypoint-initdb.d' for DB initialization scripts
Top-level 'volumes:' section declares 'oracle_data' as a named Docker volume
photoalbum-java-app service has no volume mounts — photos stored as BLOBs in Oracle DB
values: No volumes on the Java application container
